description: This file contains functions and classes related to lifting constants (tensors, ScriptObjects, FakeScriptObjects) into graph inputs within a Torch FX graph module, used in the context of exporting models. It includes a class for managing constant attributes, functions for processing and rewriting graph nodes, and mechanisms for handling script objects and fake script objects.

classes.name: ConstantAttrMap
classes.description: A mapping class that manages module constants (tensors, ScriptObjects, FakeScriptObjects) as keys, supporting aliasing and special handling for ScriptObjects.

methods.name: get_constant_fqn
methods.description: Computes the fully qualified name for a constant tensor in the module, based on node metadata.

methods.name: _get_first_fqn
methods.description: Retrieves the first FQN associated with a constant attribute from the ConstantAttrMap.

methods.name: _unused_constant
methods.description: Determines if a tensor constant node in the graph is unused and can be removed.

methods.name: lift_constants_pass
methods.description: Lifts constants (tensors, script objects) into graph inputs, modifies the graph and signature in place, and returns a mapping of constants.

methods.name: rewrite_script_object_meta
methods.description: Rewrites meta information for ScriptObjects and FakeScriptObjects in the graph to placeholder CustomObjArguments.

methods.name: _materialize_and_lift_constants
methods.description: Rewrites script object meta info and lifts constants into the graph, returning a combined constants dictionary.
